abstract: A histological review of radical orchiectomy specimens was performed to assess the impact of testicular cancer on spermatogenesis. Slides from 28 patients with testicular cancer were available for review, consisting of 14 pure seminomas, 12 embryonal carcinomas and 2 mixed tumors. For each specimen tubules adjacent (less than 3 mm.) to the tumor and distant (more than 3 mm.) from the tumor were evaluated. This study indicates that marked impairment of ipsilateral spermatogenesis is associated with testicular carcinoma, particularly in the vicinity of the tumor. The quality of distant spermatogenesis appears to be influenced by tumor type and not by elevation of known serum tumor markers, such as human chorionic gonadotropin and alpha-fetoprotein, nor by the presence of carcinoma in situ.
abstract_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術標本の組織学的見直しを行い、精巣がんが同側の精子形成に及ぼす影響を検討した。精巣がん患者28例の標本を検討に用いた。内訳は純粋セミノーマ14例、胎児性癌12例、混合型2例であった。各標本について、腫瘍から3 mm未満に隣接する精細管と、3 mm超離れた精細管を評価した。本研究の結果、精巣がん、特に腫瘍近傍では同側の精子形成が著しく障害されることが示された。遠隔部の精子形成の質は、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)などの既知の血清腫瘍マーカー値の上昇や上皮内癌の存在によらず、腫瘍型の影響を受けるように思われた。
